title: Low-degree dense-open comparison ladder
statement: Let $k,k'$ be algebraically closed fields, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], and let $X'\to X$ be the top arrow of a cartesian square over a morphism $\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback]. Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring and $F$ any sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For any dense open $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, put $G=j_!j^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. The canonical cohomologyMap comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] for $F$ are simultaneously bijective in degrees zero and one if and only if those for $G$ are simultaneously bijective in those degrees. No reducedness, torsion or constructibility hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0GJA (lemma-restrict-to-open), proof: the five-term exact sequence and remark (c)

proof.text: Apply dense_open_closed_term to obtain a short exact sequence with the actual counit as first arrow, a bijective closed-term degree-zero comparison, and vanishing degree-one cohomology on both rows.

Apply the proved pullbackCohomology_longExact_ladder. Degree-one closed-term vanishing makes both counit H¹ maps surjective. Use Mathlib.Algebra.FiveLemma additive left/right exact and four-lemma variants to prove both directions: F comparisons imply G⁰ bijective by the left-exact lemma and G¹ injective/surjective by the two four lemmas; G comparisons imply F⁰ injective/surjective by the two four lemmas and F¹ bijective by the right-exact lemma. Finally split q≤1 into q=0 and q=1.

theorem dense_open_low_base_change (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k']
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f]
    {ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of k')}
    {ι' : X' ⟶ X} (h : IsPullback ι' f' f ι)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    let G := (U.ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
      ((U.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)
    (∀ q : ℕ, q ≤ 1 → Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap ι'
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F) q)) ↔
    (∀ q : ℕ, q ≤ 1 → Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap ι'
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G) q))
